supervisor.value: Posts are advertised by specific research groups: applications go to the group leader and IFAE HR, and a Selection Committee evaluates them (online interview if needed)
supervisor.quote: Applications should be submitted to Pol Forn (pforndiaz@ifae.es | A Selection Committee will evaluate the received applications.

funding.value: Funded through predoctoral contracts on advertised posts (e.g. 6-month training contract + 4-year predoctoral contract) or competitive external fellowships (MICIN/FPI, FPU, AGAUR FI, la Caixa INPhINIT; INPhINIT incoming is open to any nationality)
funding.quote: Employment contract for practical training (maximum 6 month) + Predoctoral Contract (4 years).

also.quote: These fellowships are linked to specific research projects | 35 fellowships for early-stage researchers of any nationality to pursue their PhD studies in the best Spanish and Portuguese research centres and units with excellence distinction.

entry_route.value: The PhD advert checked requires a master's degree (or equivalent); no general IFAE rule stated
entry_route.quote: A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in quantum physics.

notes: IFAE is a public consortium of the Generalitat de Catalunya and UAB, located on the UAB campus. The doctoral degree-granting programme is not stated on the pages checked.
